elements.title: Select Data for Drawing a Scatterplot (Used with permission from Microsoft)
elements.details: Screenshot of Excel's 'Select Data Source' dialog box showing 'Range Details' with Chart data range = Sheet1!$D$1:$E$13. Legend entries (Series) shows 'Weight(pounds)'. Name = Sheet1!$E$1, X values = Sheet1!$D$2:$D$13, Y values = Sheet1!$E$2:$E$13. Behind the dialog, a partial spreadsheet is visible with columns labeled Height(inches), Weight(pounds), Age.
elements.summary: This screenshot shows how to select data for drawing a scatterplot in Excel, specifying the data range and series for height and weight.

details.trend: Weights mostly range between 180 and 250 pounds for heights between 70 and 82 inches, with one outlier at height 82 and weight 250.
